notes: Timeline Builder: a recipe board that builds stringouts, selects, day assemblies, talking-head cut-downs and reels from the clips you drag in, with a Remove silences toggle that chains the cut-down onto any build. The Sync workspace is the one sync door. Auto mode runs one shared chain per trigger. Catalog: timelapse runs as one tile, Kind and File-type filters, "Add N to project". Archive indexing lists clips in under a minute and reads metadata second. AI Cut Planner returns as a Marketplace add-on. Many fixes: Resolve never deletes what it did not make, freezes, frame-rate honesty, settings panes fit beside the dock.
added: Time of day sync, for lining up a whole day of cameras.
Tech stack, which scans this computer and tunes itself.
Ingest is a page, so several cards can land at once.
The assistant says what it knows, and every line has a switch.
